dogecoin.text: @elonmusk "Let's hope this administration proves as profitable for the country as Dogecoin has been for some of its investors. Remember, we're here to make government so efficient, it might just start paying you to work here."

Inaugural Speech: "Fellow Americans, today we embark on a journey to make government as efficient as a SpaceX rocket launch. We will streamline processes like Tesla's production line, and ensure that every dollar spent is like a Dogecoin to the moon!"
